edits.original: Access checks default to fail-closed, rather than open.
edits.reason: "Open" is the ordinary-knowledge antonym of "closed," so the trailer adds nothing to "fail-closed" and is cut.

edits.original: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.replacement: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose.
edits.reason: "By accident" is the ordinary-knowledge antonym of "on purpose," so the trailer is redundant and is cut.
